summary: Onboarding Batches read model (Issue #15). onboarding_batches now reports, for a batch at stage complete, the status of its most recent post_proof stage completion (complete has no stage result of its own, so a finished batch used to read 'not run'), adds result_stage naming the stage the result belongs to, and sorts active batches above completed ones. Same signature and grants. Read-only function replacement: no table, row, event, trigger or state-machine rule changes.

preflight.name: onboarding_batches exists exactly once (482)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'onboarding_batches'

preflight.name: onboarding_batches does not report result_stage yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'onboarding_batches' AND prosrc LIKE '%result_stage%'

expected_changes: Replaces function onboarding_batches(uuid): same signature, same fields plus result_stage; at stage complete current_status is the latest post_proof stage_completed status; active batches sort above complete ones.
No row changes; grants unchanged (service_role only).

verify.name: onboarding_batches reports result_stage
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'onboarding_batches' AND prosrc LIKE '%result_stage%' AND prosrc LIKE '%post_proof%'

verify.name: still executable by service_role only (not anon)
verify.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN has_function_privilege('service_role', 'onboarding_batches(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('anon', 'onboarding_batches(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int

verify.name: every complete batch now carries a result (none reads 'not run')
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM jsonb_array_elements(onboarding_batches(NULL)) x WHERE x->>'stage' = 'complete' AND x->>'current_status' IS NULL
